svg.title: Horizon - single-file launcher
svg.desc: Installs horizon.html in this origin's storage and serves it from a worker with the headers that let the game use its Web Workers. Its only network use is the game's own multiplayer.
svg.text: checking this browser and the launcher worker

g.aria-label: Open the game directly, without workers

svg.text: ONE FILE - EVERY TEXTURE, SOUND AND LANGUAGE INSIDE - THE NETWORK IS ONLY FOR PLAYING WITH OTHERS
